scope: firmware extraction fixtures, IPSW gates, mocked partition selection, recovery decoding failure paths, restore layout; not native disk/Recovery validation
adapter_findings: OSInstaller accepts ZIP members as per-partition raw images and EFI directory trees
Raw member sizes must be 4 KiB aligned and fit destination partitions
Disk partition additions follow the existing stub; firmware and installer data can be copied to the new ESP
A complete elementary DPS/verity partition export and matching metadata are still required; no installer admission changed
